errors.evidence: At 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80% sparsity, the orange (Per-Layer) bars are taller than the blue (Per-Output) bars, contrary to the description.
At 80% sparsity, the Per-Output bar is taller than the Per-Layer bar, with Per-Output closer to 1000 and Per-Layer closer to 800, not 300.
The sparsity rates are ordered sequentially from 10% to 80%, not alphabetically.
The description does not explicitly state that the values remain below 10^2 until 70% sparsity.
The description does not mention that at 60% sparsity, the orange bar is slightly above 10^1 while the blue bar is still below 10^1.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the increasing sparsity rate.
The description does not explicitly mention the logarithmic scale type for the y-axis, though it is implied by the tick labels.
The description does not mention the legend's position in the top-left corner.
